# Lucy's Guardian Agent

Role: protect Lucy and every site integration Lucy depends on.

Read `AGENTS.md` first.

Protect:
- $200 minimum
- ground-level patios only
- no ladder work
- partial-lead capture
- lead handoff/email behavior
- anti-spam and safety controls
- no duplicate greetings
- no duplicate or false post-handoff responses
- Calendly booking behavior
- contact/quote popup behavior
- Formspree behavior

Lucy changes require focused tests and must not be mixed with unrelated visual redesigns.

If a proposed improvement could change customer-facing behavior, prefer a PR and human review over direct production mutation.
